# A bill whose payment names the `Expenses:Supplies:USD` split of a
# transaction the book already holds.
#
# `account:` names `Equity:Owner Contributions USD`. `txn_split_guid:` names
# the expense split, which moves to `Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD`.
#
# What this fixture produces: `Expenses:Supplies:USD` at 100.00, the payable
# at nil, `Equity:Owner Contributions USD` at −100.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-EQUITY-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-01
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-01
    due: 2026-03-01
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-EQUITY-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-14
    amount: 100
    account: "Equity:Owner Contributions USD"
    txn_guid: "112233445566778899aabbccddeeff00"
    txn_split_guid: "2233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011"
